title_en: Apple tells stores how to handle iPhone Duo inner-display cracks
title_zh: 苹果向门店下发 iPhone Duo 内屏开裂处理指引
summary_en: MacRumors reports Apple sent Apple Stores and Authorized Service Providers a memo this week on diagnosing iPhone Duo inner-display cracks: technicians should inspect affected units and repair or replace them under standard procedures. The memo repeats that only a small number of units are affected; there is no recall and no public repair program.
summary_zh: 据 MacRumors 报道，苹果本周向 Apple Store 与授权服务商下发备忘录，指导如何诊断 iPhone Duo 内屏开裂：技术人员应检查涉事设备并按标准流程维修或更换。备忘录重申仅有少数设备受影响；目前没有召回，也没有公开维修计划。

title_en: iOS 27.3 beta lands next week, bringing first Apple Intelligence features to China in December
title_zh: iOS 27.3 测试版下周到来，Apple Intelligence 12 月首批登陆中国
summary_en: In a press release on its China Newsroom site, Apple said the first iOS 27.3 developer beta arrives November 4 (likely November 3 in the US) and the public release follows in December, enabling a first set of Apple Intelligence features on iPhone in China — Writing Tools, Genmoji, Clean Up, notification summaries, Visual Intelligence and Live Translation, with Alibaba's Qwen reachable for some requests. Siri AI and Image Playground are not included, and Mac/iPad support awaits further approvals.
summary_zh: 苹果在中国区 Newsroom 发布新闻稿称，iOS 27.3 首个开发者测试版将于 11 月 4 日到来（美国时间可能为 11 月 3 日），正式版 12 月发布，为中国 iPhone 首批开启 Apple Intelligence 功能——写作工具、Genmoji、消除、通知摘要、视觉智能与实时翻译，部分请求可调用阿里通义千问。Siri AI 与 Image Playground 不在首批之列，Mac/iPad 需等待进一步审批。

title_en: Unconfirmed: Gurman says ~80% of launch-day iPhone Duo stock went to Apple Stores
title_zh: 未经证实：Gurman 称 iPhone Duo 首发库存约八成给了 Apple Store（传闻）
summary_en: UNCONFIRMED: MacRumors reports Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said on his Power On podcast, citing people close to the Duo's logistics, that Apple allocated roughly 80% of initial iPhone Duo inventory to its retail stores — about 50 units at smaller stores and up to ~250 at flagships — leaving ~20% for deliveries and pickup reservations, which would explain why online delivery dates slipped to late January within minutes. Apple has not confirmed any allocation figures.
summary_zh: 未经证实：据 MacRumors 报道，彭博社 Mark Gurman 在 Power On 播客中援引接近 Duo 物流的人士称，苹果将 iPhone Duo 首批库存约 80% 分配给了零售门店——小店约 50 台、旗舰店最高约 250 台——仅约 20% 留给配送与到店取货预订，这或可解释线上发货日期为何在几分钟内滑到 1 月底。苹果未确认任何分配数字。

title_en: iOS 27.2 brings Apple TV Multiview to iPhone — four sports streams at once, ideal on Duo's big screen
title_zh: iOS 27.2 把 Apple TV Multiview 带到 iPhone：同时看四路体育直播，Duo 大屏尤其合适
summary_en: 9to5Mac reports iOS 27.2 adds Multiview to the Apple TV app on iPhone, letting users watch up to four live sports streams at once — a feature previously limited to Apple TV, iPad and Vision Pro, and especially well suited to the iPhone Duo's large unfolded display.
summary_zh: 据 9to5Mac 报道，iOS 27.2 为 iPhone 上的 Apple TV App 新增 Multiview，可同时观看最多四路体育直播——此前仅限 Apple TV、iPad 与 Vision Pro，在 iPhone Duo 展开的大屏上尤其合适。

title_en: iOS 27.2 Shortcuts adds 'When my iPhone is opened or closed' automation for iPhone Duo
title_zh: iOS 27.2 快捷指令新增 iPhone Duo 专属自动化：「打开或合上时」触发
summary_en: Per Apple's Shortcuts release notes covered by 9to5Mac, iOS 27.2 adds a Duo-only automation trigger — 'When my iPhone is opened or closed' — so folding or unfolding the phone can run a shortcut. The same update improves Workout and App automations.
summary_zh: 据 9to5Mac 报道的苹果快捷指令更新说明，iOS 27.2 新增 Duo 专属自动化触发条件——「当我的 iPhone 打开或合上时」——开合手机即可运行快捷指令；同版还改进了体能训练与 App 自动化。

title_en: Wider extension lets Safari use the full front screen on iPhone Duo
title_zh: Wider 扩展让 Safari 用上 iPhone Duo 外屏的完整宽度
summary_en: AppleInsider reports Wider, a free Safari extension, lets web pages extend into the strip beside Safari's side controls on the Duo's 5.4-inch outer screen, with a sidebar button toggling between normal and wide views per page.
summary_zh: 据 AppleInsider 报道，免费 Safari 扩展 Wider 可让网页延伸到 Duo 5.4 英寸外屏上 Safari 侧边控件旁的条带区域，通过侧栏按钮按页面切换普通/宽屏视图。

title_en: Ford app updated for iPhone Duo with two-pane open view
title_zh: Ford App 已适配 iPhone Duo，展开为左右双栏
summary_en: Ford Authority reports the Ford app has been updated for the iPhone Duo, announced by Ford CEO Jim Farley in an October 27 social post. Folded, the app looks normal; unfolded, the vehicle image, fuel level, location and lock/unlock controls sit on the left of the inner screen, with schedule, software updates, vehicle details, drivers and connected services on the right.
summary_zh: 据 Ford Authority，Ford App 已适配 iPhone Duo，消息由福特 CEO Jim Farley 在 10 月 27 日的社交帖子中公布。合上时界面与普通手机无异；展开后，车辆图片、油量、位置与锁车/解锁控制位于内屏左侧，右侧为日程、软件更新、车辆详情、驾驶员与互联服务。

title_en: Unconfirmed leak claims Apple relaxed iPhone Duo quality checks amid screen failures
title_zh: 未经证实爆料称苹果曾放宽 iPhone Duo 质检标准（传闻）
summary_en: UNCONFIRMED: Nokiamob, citing a Jiemian News report, says an unnamed Foxconn whistleblower claims Apple relaxed quality-control protocols on the iPhone Duo line to keep supply up, and that specific components were emergency-swapped in response to the display failures. The claim is single-source and unverified; neither Apple nor Foxconn has confirmed it.
summary_zh: 未经证实：Nokiamob 援引界面新闻报道称，一名未具名的富士康爆料者声称苹果为保供货放宽了 iPhone Duo 产线的质检标准，并已针对屏幕故障紧急更换了特定部件。该说法为单一来源、未经核实，苹果与富士康均未确认。

title_en: Apple announces MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR touch display, from $2,899
title_zh: 苹果正式发布 PROLED XDR 触屏 MacBook Pro，2899 美元起
summary_en: Announced October 28, confirming the previous day's reports: Apple's first touchscreen Mac pairs a tandem-OLED PROLED XDR display (up to 2,000 nits, 10,000,000:1 contrast, 10-120Hz) with M5 Pro / M5 Max chips, a Dynamic Island in place of the notch, a glowing Apple logo, and a thinner, lighter body (3 lb for 14-inch, 4 lb for 16-inch). macOS translates touch into clicks so existing apps work. From $2,899 (14-inch) / $3,399 (16-inch); pre-orders open, availability November 6.
summary_zh: 10 月 28 日正式发布，证实此前一天的报道：苹果首款触屏 Mac 采用串联 OLED 的 PROLED XDR 屏（最高 2000 尼特、1000 万:1 对比度、10–120Hz），搭载 M5 Pro / M5 Max，灵动岛取代刘海，发光 Apple 标志回归，机身更薄更轻（14 寸 3 磅、16 寸 4 磅）。macOS 可将触控自动转为点击，现有应用可直接使用。2899 美元（14 寸）/ 3399 美元（16 寸）起，已开放预订，11 月 6 日发售。

title_en: TrendForce: iPhone Duo could take 29.8% of foldable shipments in 2027
title_zh: TrendForce：iPhone Duo 2027 年或占折叠屏出货量 29.8%
summary_en: 9to5Mac reports TrendForce reiterated its forecast that Apple will capture 29.8% of global foldable smartphone shipments in 2027, second behind Samsung (31.9%, down from 35.1% in 2026) and ahead of Huawei (21.3%). TrendForce expects the foldable market to reach about 23.5 million units in 2027, up 16.3%, and credits Apple's chip, OS and developer-ecosystem integration. This is an analyst forecast, not a result.
summary_zh: 据 9to5Mac，TrendForce 重申预测：苹果 2027 年将占全球折叠屏手机出货量的 29.8%，居第二，仅次于三星（31.9%，低于 2026 年的 35.1%），高于华为（21.3%）。TrendForce 预计 2027 年折叠屏市场约 2350 万台、增长 16.3%，并将苹果的优势归于芯片、系统与开发者生态的整合。此为分析师预测，并非实际结果。

title_en: iPhone Duo hinge supplier FineMTEC denies its components caused inner-display failures, weighs legal action
title_zh: iPhone Duo 铰链供应商 FineMTEC 否认其部件导致内屏故障，考虑采取法律行动
summary_en: South Korean supplier FineMTEC, linked to the iPhone Duo's hinge-related components, has denied that defects in its parts are responsible for the reported inner-display failures and warned it could pursue legal action over what it calls false information. Neither Apple nor FineMTEC has confirmed the cause of the cracks; Apple has acknowledged an issue on a small number of units and offers replacements through AppleCare.
summary_zh: 与 iPhone Duo 铰链相关部件有关的韩国供应商 FineMTEC 否认其部件缺陷导致了内屏故障报告，并警告可能就其所称的不实信息采取法律行动。苹果与 FineMTEC 均未确认裂纹成因；苹果已承认少量设备存在该问题，可通过 AppleCare 换机。

title_en: Apple opens pre-orders today for five new products, including iPad mini, M6 iMac and M6 MacBook Pro
title_zh: 苹果今日开放五款新品预订，包括 iPad mini、M6 iMac 与 M6 MacBook Pro
summary_en: MacRumors reports pre-orders open Wednesday October 28 at 10:10 a.m. Pacific for the OLED iPad mini with A20 Pro (from $699), the iMac with M6 (from $1,499) and the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 (from $1,999), with availability from Friday November 6. Bloomberg reports pre-orders for the yet-to-be-announced touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro models (14-inch and 16-inch, expected from $2,899 and $3,399) will also begin Wednesday after Apple's 'Pro and tell' event in Los Angeles; those touchscreen models had not been announced by Apple as of this report.
summary_zh: 据 MacRumors，10月28日（周三）太平洋时间上午10:10 开放预订：OLED 版 iPad mini（A20 Pro，699 美元起）、M6 iMac（1,499 美元起）与 14 英寸 M6 MacBook Pro（1,999 美元起），11月6日（周五）起发售。据彭博社报道，尚未正式发布的触屏 OLED MacBook Pro（14/16 英寸，预计 2,899 / 3,399 美元起）也将在洛杉矶「Pro and tell」活动后于周三开放预订；截至该报道，苹果尚未正式发布触屏机型。

title_en: Apple expected to announce touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro on October 28
title_zh: 苹果预计10月28日发布触屏OLED MacBook Pro
summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple will announce 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with touch-enabled OLED displays, a Dynamic Island, M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, and a lighter design at the October 28 'Pro and tell' experience. As of October 27 the models had not been announced by Apple.
summary_zh: 彭博社Mark Gurman报道，苹果将在10月28日“Pro and tell”活动上发布14英寸和16英寸MacBook Pro，配备触控OLED屏、灵动岛、M5 Pro和M5 Max芯片及更轻设计。截至10月27日，苹果尚未正式发布这些机型。

summary_en: Announced October 27: M6 chip with 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU and dual 16-core Neural Engine; up to 30% faster graphics and 25% faster AI workloads than M5, up to 24 hours of battery life, Wi-Fi 7. Starts at $1,999 with 16GB unified memory and 1TB storage, in Space Black and Silver. Pre-orders open October 28, availability November 6. A new M6 iMac (from $1,499) was announced the same day.
summary_zh: 10 月 27 日发布：M6 芯片（12 核 CPU、12 核 GPU、双 16 核神经网络引擎），图形比 M5 快最高 30%、AI 快最高 25%，续航最长 24 小时，Wi-Fi 7。1999 美元起，标配 16GB 内存 + 1TB 存储，深空黑与银色。10 月 28 日预订，11 月 6 日发售。同日还发布了 M6 版 iMac，1499 美元起。
title_en: Apple unveils 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6, from $1,999
title_zh: 苹果发布 M6 版 14 寸 MacBook Pro，1999 美元起

summary_en: Announced October 27 alongside the M6 MacBook Pro: the iMac moves from M4 to M6, with up to 5x faster on-device AI performance than the M4 model, per Apple. Starts at $1,499; pre-orders October 28, availability November 6.
summary_zh: 10 月 27 日与 M6 MacBook Pro 同场发布：iMac 从 M4 直接跳到 M6，苹果称端侧 AI 性能比 M4 版快最高 5 倍。1499 美元起，10 月 28 日预订，11 月 6 日发售。
title_en: Apple announces iMac with M6, from $1,499
title_zh: 苹果发布 M6 版 iMac，1499 美元起

source_name: Reuters (reporting Apple's official statement); corroborated by MacRumors
summary_en: Over the Oct 24–25 weekend, some iPhone Duo owners reported cracks and lines along the inner display's center hinge — in some cases within hours of first use — in an episode nicknamed 'crackgate' online, though some circulating images were reportedly fake or AI-generated. Apple said on Monday Oct 26 that it is aware of an issue affecting a small number of units and that affected users should contact AppleCare for a replacement (a replacement for this issue does not require an AppleCare+ subscription, per Notebookcheck); iFixit's unconfirmed analysis suggests the hinge's center support bar may not retract fully, creating a stress hotspot near the display cable.
summary_zh: 10 月 24–25 日周末期间，部分 iPhone Duo 用户报告内屏中央铰链处出现裂纹或线条，有些在首次使用数小时内即出现，该事件在网上被戏称为「crackgate」；不过据报道，部分流传图片为伪造或 AI 生成。苹果于 10 月 26 日（周一）回应称，已知悉该问题影响少量设备，受影响用户应联系 AppleCare 换机（据 Notebookcheck，此问题换机无需 AppleCare+ 订阅）。iFixit 未经证实的分析认为，铰链中央支撑条可能未完全收回，在屏幕排线附近形成应力热点——此为推测，未经证实。
title_en: Apple to replace iPhone Duo units showing inner-display cracks after weekend 'crackgate' reports
title_zh: iPhone Duo 内屏裂纹「crackgate」发酵，苹果回应：受影响用户可联系 AppleCare 换机

summary_en: Apple announced the all-new iPad mini on October 26: 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR OLED (up to 1,200 nits peak, 24% thinner bezels), A20 Pro chip built on 2nm, IP67 water and dust resistance, 5.4mm thin and 255g, 12MP Center Stage front camera on the landscape edge, Wi-Fi 7. Storage 128/256/512GB in Midnight and Starlight; the 512GB model gets an extra CPU core and dual 16-core Neural Engine. Wi-Fi from $699, Wi-Fi + Cellular from $849. US pre-orders October 28, availability November 6.
summary_zh: 苹果 10 月 26 日发布全新 iPad mini：8.5 英寸 Super Retina XDR OLED 屏（峰值 1200 尼特，边框窄 24%），2 纳米 A20 Pro 芯片，IP67 防水防尘，机身 5.4 毫米、255 克，横边 12MP Center Stage 前摄，Wi-Fi 7。128/256/512GB，午夜色与星光色；512GB 版 CPU 多一核并配双 16 核神经网络引擎。Wi-Fi 版 699 美元起，蜂窝版 849 美元起。美国 10 月 28 日预订，11 月 6 日发售。
title_en: New iPad mini is official: 8.5-inch OLED, A20 Pro, IP67, from $699
title_zh: 新款 iPad mini 发布：8.5 寸 OLED、A20 Pro、IP67，699 美元起

title_en: iOS 27.2 fixes more than 160 security vulnerabilities
title_zh: iOS 27.2修复逾160个安全漏洞
summary_en: Apple's iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 updates fix more than 160 security vulnerabilities, including more than 30 WebKit fixes and about 15 kernel bugs, according to MacRumors. Apple did not say any of the flaws were known to be actively exploited.
summary_zh: 据MacRumors，苹果iOS 27.2和iPadOS 27.2修复了160多个安全漏洞，包括30多个WebKit修复和约15个内核漏洞。苹果未表示有任何漏洞已知被实际利用。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages
title_zh: 苹果发布iOS 27.2，Siri AI新增多国语言
summary_en: Apple released iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 on October 26 for all devices that run iOS 27, including iPhone Duo, uniting the Duo and other iPhones on one version. The update adds Siri AI in French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish, Siri conversation recall, Messages suggestions, Apple TV app profiles, and, for the Duo, Apple Pencil support.
summary_zh: 苹果10月26日为所有运行iOS 27的设备（包括iPhone Duo）发布iOS 27.2和iPadOS 27.2，使Duo与其他iPhone统一到同一版本。此更新为Siri AI新增法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语，加入Siri对话记忆、信息建议、Apple TV应用个人资料，并为Duo带来Apple Pencil支持。

title_en: iPhone Duo fails JerryRigEverything dusty durability test
title_zh: iPhone Duo未通过JerryRigEverything多尘耐久测试
summary_en: MacRumors reported that the iPhone Duo failed JerryRigEverything's durability test, with dust entering the hinge despite its IP68 rating and a bend test leaving a permanent green line across the inner display before it became unresponsive. The outer screen scratched at Mohs level 7 and the inner screen at level 2.
summary_zh: MacRumors报道，iPhone Duo未通过JerryRigEverything耐久测试：尽管有IP68评级，灰尘仍进入铰链，弯折测试后内屏出现永久绿线并最终无响应。外屏在莫氏7级出现划痕，内屏在2级即出现划痕。

title_en: WeChat remotely enables simultaneous login on iPhone Duo (gradual rollout)
title_zh: 微信远程升级：iPhone Duo 可与其他设备同时登录（灰度开放）
summary_en: IT之家 reported on Oct 24 that WeChat remotely switched on 'log in together with other devices' for some iPhone Duo units: after scanning, the main device shows an iPad WeChat login prompt — a partial, still-maturing feature rather than full tablet mode, and not yet live on every unit.
summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日报道，微信远程升级后，部分 iPhone Duo 已出现「和其他设备同时登录」：扫码后主设备提示「登录 iPad 微信」。该功能尚属不完全体、仍在灰度开放，并非完整平板模式，也未覆盖全部设备。
source_name: IT之家 via 新浪财经 (2026-10-24)

title_en: iPhone Duo released October 23, sells out on launch day as resale listings reach $10,000
title_zh: iPhone Duo 10月23日发售，首日售罄、转售价达1万美元
summary_en: Apple's first foldable iPhone, announced September 9, went on sale on Friday, October 23, 2026, and sold out within hours at stores including New York's Fifth Avenue location. Resellers listed devices on eBay for as much as $10,000, well above the $1,999 starting price.
summary_zh: 苹果首款折叠iPhone于9月9日发布，2026年10月23日周五正式发售，在纽约第五大道等门店数小时内售罄。转售者在eBay上标价高达10000美元，远高于1999美元的起售价。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 27.1 exclusively for iPhone Duo
title_zh: 苹果发布仅供iPhone Duo的iOS 27.1
summary_en: Apple released the final version of iOS 27.1 exclusively for the iPhone Duo ahead of its October 23 launch, with other iPhones remaining on iOS 27.0.1 until iOS 27.2. Apple's security releases page lists iOS 27.1 for iPhone Duo only, dated October 23, with no published security fixes, and the on-device notes cite only bug fixes.
summary_zh: 苹果在10月23日发售前发布了仅供iPhone Duo的iOS 27.1正式版，其他iPhone在iOS 27.2到来前仍停留在27.0.1。苹果安全发布页面将iOS 27.1列为仅限Duo、日期为10月23日、无已公布安全修复，设备上的说明仅提及错误修复。

title_en: Apple adds 'Made for iPhone Duo' App Store badge
title_zh: 苹果在App Store新增“Made for iPhone Duo”徽章
summary_en: Apple added a 'Made for iPhone Duo' badge to App Store product pages to identify apps optimized for its first foldable iPhone, starting October 23, along with editorial collections. Apple said apps including Netflix, Prime Video, Slack, Zoom and Fantastical were being adapted for the larger inner display and folding positions.
summary_zh: 苹果在App Store产品页新增“Made for iPhone Duo”徽章，自10月23日起标识为其首款折叠iPhone优化的应用，并推出编辑精选合集。苹果称Netflix、Prime Video、Slack、Zoom和Fantastical等应用正在为更大的内屏和折叠形态进行适配。

title_en: iPhone Duo gains Apple Pencil support in iOS 27.2 release candidate
title_zh: iPhone Duo在iOS 27.2候选版中获得Apple Pencil支持
summary_en: MacRumors reported on October 21 that the iPhone Duo gains Apple Pencil support in iOS 27.2, based on testing of the release candidate by analyst Max Weinbach. Only the USB-C Apple Pencil is supported, for drawing, annotating and scrolling on both the inner and outer displays.
summary_zh: MacRumors 10月21日报道，基于分析师Max Weinbach对候选版的测试，iPhone Duo在iOS 27.2中获得Apple Pencil支持。仅支持USB-C版Apple Pencil，可在内外双屏上绘画、批注和滚动。

title_en: Xcode 27.1 released with Swift 6.4 and iPhone Duo SDK
title_zh: Xcode 27.1发布，含Swift 6.4与iPhone Duo SDK
summary_en: Apple released Xcode 27.1 (build 27A9275) on October 15 with Swift 6.4 and the SDK for iOS 27.1, the version developers use to build Duo apps, according to MacObserver's October 19 report. App Store Connect began accepting apps built with it the same day, though StandBy and most app extensions are unavailable in the Duo simulator.
summary_zh: 据MacObserver 10月19日报道，苹果10月15日发布Xcode 27.1（构建27A9275），含Swift 6.4和iOS 27.1 SDK，即开发者构建Duo应用所用的版本。App Store Connect同日开始接受用其构建的应用，但Duo模拟器中待机显示和多数应用扩展不可用。

title_en: Apple announces October 28 'Pro and tell' event in Los Angeles
title_zh: 苹果宣布10月28日在洛杉矶举行“Pro and tell”活动
summary_en: Apple announced on October 19 a special event on Wednesday, October 28 at 10 a.m. PT in Los Angeles, teased by Greg Joswiak with the tagline 'Pro and tell.' As of October 27 the event had not yet happened, and Apple had not announced its products.
summary_zh: 苹果10月19日宣布将于10月28日周三上午10点（太平洋时间）在洛杉矶举行特别活动，Greg Joswiak以“Pro and tell”为标语预热。截至10月27日活动尚未举行，苹果也未公布其产品。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 27.2 release candidate to developers
title_zh: 苹果向开发者发布iOS 27.2候选版
summary_en: Apple seeded the iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 release candidates to developers on October 19, a week after beta 4. The RC expanded Siri AI to five new languages and added Apple TV app profiles, while the redesigned Health app tested in the beta was removed for a later update.
summary_zh: 苹果10月19日向开发者推送iOS 27.2和iPadOS 27.2候选版，距beta 4一周。候选版将Siri AI扩展到五种新语言并加入Apple TV应用个人资料，而beta中测试的重新设计的健康应用被移除、推迟到后续更新。

title_en: iPhone Duo pre-orders sell out in minutes, shipping slips to January 2027
title_zh: iPhone Duo预购数分钟售罄，发货推迟至2027年1月
summary_en: iPhone Duo pre-orders opened October 16 and sold out within minutes, with U.S. shipping estimates slipping to January 25, 2027. Confirmed pre-orders resold on eBay for up to $4,999.99, including a 2TB model that retails for $3,199.
summary_zh: iPhone Duo预购10月16日开启后数分钟内售罄，美国发货预估推迟至2027年1月25日。已确认的预购订单在eBay上转售最高达4999.99美元，包括一款零售价3199美元的2TB机型。

title_en: Apple announces HomePod mini 2 with Siri AI
title_zh: 苹果发布带Siri AI的HomePod mini 2
summary_en: Apple announced HomePod mini 2 on October 13 for $149, with an S10 chip, Sound Glow, new colors and Siri AI coming in a future software update. It can be pre-ordered in pink, green, blue, white and midnight, with availability beginning October 30.
summary_zh: 苹果10月13日发布149美元的HomePod mini 2，配备S10芯片、Sound Glow、新配色，Siri AI将在未来软件更新中到来。提供粉、绿、蓝、白和午夜色，即日起可预购，10月30日发售。

title_en: Apple announces fourth-generation Apple TV 4K with A19 chip
title_zh: 苹果发布搭载A19芯片的第四代Apple TV 4K
summary_en: Apple announced the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K on October 13 with an A19 chip, Siri AI support, and an updated Siri Remote with Find My and Precision Finding, priced at $299. Pre-orders opened October 13 with launch on November 13.
summary_zh: 苹果10月13日发布第四代Apple TV 4K，搭载A19芯片、支持Siri AI，配备带查找和精确查找功能的新款Siri Remote，售价299美元。10月13日开启预购，11月13日发售。

title_en: Apple introduces HomeView smart home hub
title_zh: 苹果推出HomeView智能家居中枢
summary_en: Apple introduced HomeView on October 13, a $299 smart display with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display, Siri AI and face recognition for up to six users, in countertop and wall-mounted versions. Pre-orders opened October 13 with availability on November 13.
summary_zh: 苹果10月13日推出HomeView，一款299美元的智能显示屏，配备7英寸Liquid Retina屏、Siri AI及最多六人的面部识别，有桌面版和壁挂版。10月13日开启预购，11月13日发售。

title_en: Apple introduces Apple Home Collection accessories with LG and Schneider Electric
title_zh: 苹果与LG和施耐德电气推出Apple Home Collection配件
summary_en: Apple announced Apple Home Collection on October 13, a lineup of cameras, thermostats, temperature sensors, and a video doorbell and door lock designed with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric. The accessories are set up with one tap on iPhone and managed in the Apple Home app, with availability beginning in December.
summary_zh: 苹果10月13日发布Apple Home Collection，这是与LG电子和施耐德电气共同设计的摄像头、恒温器、温湿度传感器、视频门铃和门锁系列。这些配件可通过iPhone一键设置并在苹果Home应用中管理，12月起发售。

title_en: Apple says some AT&T iPhone 18 Pro Max phones must be replaced over cellular bug
title_zh: 苹果称部分AT&T版iPhone 18 Pro Max因蜂窝故障需更换
summary_en: USA Today reported on October 8 that a small number of AT&T iPhone 18 Pro Max phones lost cellular service and must be replaced. Apple released iOS 27.0.1 and a carrier settings update intended to prevent the issue on other devices; other carriers and the iPhone 18 Pro were not affected.
summary_zh: USA Today 10月8日报道，少数AT&T版iPhone 18 Pro Max失去蜂窝服务、必须更换。苹果发布了iOS 27.0.1和运营商设置更新以防止其他设备出现该问题；其他运营商及iPhone 18 Pro未受影响。

title_en: Apple makes iOS 27.0.1 the prominent update for users still on iOS 26
title_zh: 苹果将iOS 27.0.1设为iOS 26用户的主要更新提示
summary_en: Starting October 8, iPhone users still on iOS 26 see iOS 27.0.1 as the prominent update in Settings, with iOS 26.7.1 moved to 'Also Available,' MacRumors reported. iOS 27.0.1 itself was released on September 28, outside this window, with Face ID and other bug fixes.
summary_zh: MacRumors报道，自10月8日起，仍在使用iOS 26的iPhone用户在设置中会看到iOS 27.0.1成为主要更新提示，iOS 26.7.1被移至“也可用”区域。iOS 27.0.1本身于9月28日（本窗口之外）发布，含Face ID等错误修复。

title_en: Apple releases third developer betas of iOS 27.2 and macOS 27.2
title_zh: 苹果发布iOS 27.2和macOS 27.2第三个开发者测试版
summary_en: Apple released the third developer betas of iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, macOS 27.2 and other platforms on October 5, with iOS 27.2 beta 3 at build 24B5099f. The 27.2 cycle skipped a public 27.1 for non-Duo iPhones because 27.1 was built for the iPhone Duo.
summary_zh: 苹果10月5日发布iOS 27.2、iPadOS 27.2、macOS 27.2等平台的第三个开发者测试版，iOS 27.2 beta 3构建号为24B5099f。由于27.1专为iPhone Duo打造，非Duo iPhone在27.2周期中跳过了公开的27.1。

title_en: iPhone Duo could be extremely difficult to buy at launch
title_zh: iPhone Duo 首发可能极难买到
summary_en: Supply-chain reports pointed to constrained early availability, with Jiemian News reporting Foxconn final-assembly yields slightly above 60% as of September 17 and analyst Jeff Pu cutting his 2026 shipment estimate from 7 million to 6 million units over hinge constraints. Apple had set pre-orders for October 16 and availability for October 23.
summary_zh: 供应链报道指出首发供货可能紧张：界面新闻称截至9月17日富士康最终组装良率仅略高于60%，分析师Jeff Pu因铰链限制将2026年出货预期从700万台下调至600万台。苹果定于10月16日预购、10月23日发售。

title_en: iPhone 18 Pro sales rise 12% YoY in China launch week, lifting Apple to No. 1
title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 中国首周销量同比增长12%，助苹果登顶
summary_en: Counterpoint Research reported the iPhone 18 Pro series posted a 12% year-over-year sales increase in its first week in China, taking about 33% of China's smartphone sales in the September 14-20 week despite being available only the final three days. The Pro models went on sale September 18.
summary_zh: Counterpoint Research报道，iPhone 18 Pro系列在中国首周销量同比增长12%，在9月14日至20日一周内拿下约33%的中国智能手机销量，尽管仅售卖最后三天。Pro机型于9月18日发售。

title_en: Report: Apple's next launch is October 13, with smart-home products expected
title_zh: 报道：苹果下一次发布定在10月13日，预计推出智能家居产品
summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported Apple planned to unveil an all-new smart home hub, a new HomePod mini, and a new Apple TV 4K on Tuesday, October 13, with Siri AI expected as a key feature. Apple had not confirmed the products in the report.
summary_zh: Bloomberg的Mark Gurman报道称，苹果计划于10月13日星期二发布全新智能家居中枢、新款HomePod mini和新款Apple TV 4K，Siri AI预计为核心功能。该报道中苹果尚未确认这些产品。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 27.0.1 with Face ID bug fix
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 27.0.1，修复 Face ID 问题
summary_en: Apple released iOS 27.0.1, the first update to iOS 27, fixing iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max devices that could unexpectedly restart when Face ID failed to authenticate, a 2x photo color artifact, and a touchscreen freeze when opening Notification Center and Control Center together. iPadOS 27.0.1 and visionOS 27.0.1 were also released.
summary_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 27 的首个更新 27.0.1，修复 iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 在 Face ID 认证失败时可能意外重启、2倍照片色彩伪影，以及同时打开通知中心和控制中心时触屏无响应的问题。iPadOS 27.0.1 和 visionOS 27.0.1 也同步发布。

title_en: iPhone Duo launching October 23 with foldable features recapped
title_zh: iPhone Duo 将于10月23日发售，折叠功能汇总
summary_en: MacRumors recapped that Apple announced the iPhone Duo on September 9, with pre-orders on Friday, October 16 and availability on Friday, October 23. Features listed included 7.6-inch inner and 5.4-inch outer displays, titanium enclosure, Touch ID in the side button, dual 48MP rear cameras, Split View, and the A20 Pro chip.
summary_zh: MacRumors汇总称，苹果于9月9日发布 iPhone Duo，10月16日星期五预购，10月23日星期五发售。功能包括7.6英寸内屏和5.4英寸外屏、钛金属机身、侧边按钮Touch ID、双48MP后摄、分屏视图和A20 Pro芯片。

title_en: iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4 and AirPods 5 go on sale
title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro、Apple Watch Series 12、Ultra 4 与 AirPods 5 正式发售
summary_en: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max officially went on sale on September 18, alongside Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5, with Apple Stores changing layouts for the launch. The iPhone Duo was not part of this launch day; its availability was set for October 23.
summary_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 于9月18日正式发售，同日发售的还有 Apple Watch Series 12、Ultra 4 和 AirPods 5，苹果零售店为此次发售调整了陈列。iPhone Duo 不在本次发售之列，其发售日为10月23日。

title_en: iPhone 18 Pro camera review tests variable aperture and film look
title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 相机评测：测试可变光圈与胶片效果
summary_en: Photographer Tyler Stalman's camera review, published as Apple's media embargo lifted, tested the iPhone 18 Pro's new variable-aperture main camera, which moves from f/1.8 to f/1.48, and new Photographic Styles texture controls. He found the wider aperture produced slightly more natural background blur, though the difference was not dramatic.
summary_zh: 摄影师Tyler Stalman在苹果媒体禁令解除当天发布的相机评测测试了 iPhone 18 Pro 新的可变光圈主摄（从f/1.8变为f/1.48）和新的摄影风格纹理控制。他认为更宽的光圈带来略更自然的背景虚化，但差异并不显著。

title_en: macOS 27 Golden Gate released for Apple silicon Macs
title_zh: macOS 27 Golden Gate 发布，仅支持 Apple 芯片 Mac
summary_en: Apple released macOS 27 Golden Gate on September 14 as a free update requiring a Mac with an Apple silicon chip, and not available on Intel Macs. It introduces Siri AI with a dedicated Siri app, brings Visual Intelligence to the Mac, and tweaks the Liquid Glass design.
summary_zh: 苹果于9月14日发布 macOS 27 Golden Gate，为免费更新，需要搭载Apple芯片的Mac，不支持Intel Mac。它带来带独立Siri应用的Siri AI、首次登陆Mac的视觉智能，以及Liquid Glass设计调整。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 with Siri AI and Liquid Glass update
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 27 与 iPadOS 27，带来 Siri AI 与 Liquid Glass 更新
summary_en: Apple released iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 on September 14 as free updates for compatible devices, including iPhone 11 series and later and iPhone SE 2 and later for iOS. The updates introduce Siri AI with a dedicated Siri app, personal context, onscreen awareness, and Liquid Glass refinements; Apple Intelligence features require iPhone 15 Pro or later models listed by Apple.
summary_zh: 苹果于9月14日发布 iOS 27 和 iPadOS 27，为兼容设备提供免费更新，iOS 支持 iPhone 11 系列及后续机型和 iPhone SE 2 及后续机型。更新带来带独立Siri应用的Siri AI、个人上下文、屏幕感知和Liquid Glass改进；Apple Intelligence功能需要iPhone 15 Pro或苹果列出的后续机型。

title_en: The MacRumors Show: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo announced
title_zh: MacRumors节目：iPhone 18 Pro 与 iPhone Duo 已发布
summary_en: MacRumors' recap described the iPhone Duo as a book-style foldable with a 7.6-inch inner and 5.4-inch outer display, titanium frame, IP68 rating, Touch ID in the side button, A20 Pro and C2 modem, starting at $1,999 with pre-orders October 16 and an October 23 launch. It also covered Apple Watch Series 12 starting at $399 and AirPods 5 at $129 and $149.
summary_zh: MacRumors的回顾称 iPhone Duo 为书本式折叠机，配备7.6英寸内屏和5.4英寸外屏、钛金属边框、IP68、侧边按钮Touch ID、A20 Pro和C2调制解调器，起价1,999美元，10月16日预购、10月23日发售。节目还介绍了起价399美元的Apple Watch Series 12和129/149美元的AirPods 5。

title_en: Apple event recap: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5
title_zh: 苹果发布会回顾：iPhone Duo、iPhone 18 Pro、Watch Series 12 与 AirPods 5
summary_en: The Mac Observer's recap of the September 9 'Surprise and shine' event listed iPhone 18 Pro from $1,199 and Pro Max from $1,299, iPhone Duo from $1,999, AirPods 5 from $129, Apple Watch Series 12 from $399 and Ultra 4 from $799, with most products in stores September 18 and Duo on October 23. It noted the event was John Ternus's first keynote as CEO and that iOS 27 would arrive September 14.
summary_zh: Mac Observer对9月9日“Surprise and shine”发布会的回顾列出：iPhone 18 Pro起价1,199美元、Pro Max 1,299美元、iPhone Duo 1,999美元、AirPods 5 129美元起、Apple Watch Series 12 399美元起、Ultra 4 799美元起，多数产品9月18日到店，Duo为10月23日。报道还指出这是John Ternus作为CEO的首次主题演讲，iOS 27将于9月14日推出。

title_en: Apple confirms daily usage limits for Siri AI, with paid expanded access planned
title_zh: 苹果确认 Siri AI 有每日使用限制，付费扩展访问将在未来推出
summary_en: Apple confirmed on September 9 that there will be a daily usage limit for Siri AI and other server-model Apple Intelligence features, with expanded access available for a fee in the future. Apple did not provide the fee or charging details in the report.
summary_zh: 苹果于9月9日确认，Siri AI及其他依赖服务器模型的Apple Intelligence功能将设有每日使用限制，未来可付费获得扩展访问。该报道中苹果未提供费用或收费方式细节。

title_en: Hands-on with iPhone Duo: the crease is still there, but barely
title_zh: iPhone Duo 上手：折痕仍在，但几乎看不见
summary_en: In media hands-on after the September 9 event, MacRumors found the $1,999 iPhone Duo felt premium, thin and sturdy, and that its nano-texture inner display minimized the look and feel of the fold crease, though the crease was still visible in certain lighting. The outer display is 5.4 inches and the inner display 7.6 inches.
summary_zh: 在9月9日发布会后的媒体上手环节，MacRumors认为1,999美元的iPhone Duo质感高级、轻薄且坚固，其纳米纹理内屏最大限度减少了折痕的观感和触感，但在某些光线下折痕仍可见。外屏为5.4英寸，内屏为7.6英寸。

title_en: Apple launches iPhone Duo developer resources ahead of October release
title_zh: 苹果在10月发售前推出 iPhone Duo 开发者资源
summary_en: Following the iPhone Duo announcement, Apple launched developer resources including a 'Get ready for iPhone Duo' page, Group Labs scheduled September 16 and 17, and workshops on optimizing apps and resizability. The device was unveiled alongside iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, and AirPods 5 with ANC.
summary_zh: 在iPhone Duo发布后，苹果推出开发者资源，包括“为iPhone Duo做好准备”页面、定于9月16和17日的Group Labs，以及优化应用和可调整尺寸的研讨会。该设备与iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max、Apple Watch Series 12和Ultra 4、带降噪的AirPods 5一同发布。

title_en: Apple announces iOS 27 release date: September 14
title_zh: 苹果宣布 iOS 27 发布日期：9月14日
summary_en: At its September 9 event Apple announced iOS 27 would be released for all users with a compatible iPhone on Monday, September 14, after developer beta testing since June and public beta testing since July. iOS 27 is compatible with the same models as iOS 26, iPhone 11 series and newer, and iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27 and visionOS 27 were also set for September 14.
summary_zh: 苹果在9月9日发布会上宣布，iOS 27将于9月14日星期一向所有兼容iPhone用户发布，此前已从6月进行开发者测试、7月进行公开测试。iOS 27兼容与iOS 26相同的机型，即iPhone 11系列及后续机型；iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27、tvOS 27和visionOS 27也定于9月14日发布。

title_en: Apple seeds iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 release candidates
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 27 与 iPadOS 27 候选版本
summary_en: Apple seeded release candidate versions of iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 on September 9, a week after the eighth betas, as the last beta updates before public release if no bugs were found. Registered developers and public beta testers could download them from Settings > General > Software Update.
summary_zh: 苹果于9月9日发布iOS 27和iPadOS 27的候选版本，距第八个测试版一周，如未发现问题将是公开发布前的最后测试更新。注册开发者和公开测试者可从“设置 > 通用 > 软件更新”下载。

title_en: Apple Watch Series 12 announced at $399 with new Health Sensing System
title_zh: Apple Watch Series 12 发布，399美元起，配备新健康传感系统
summary_en: Apple announced Apple Watch Series 12 at its 'Surprise and shine' event with a starting price of $399, pre-orders open September 9 and in-store availability September 18. Its headline Health Sensing System measures heart rate every 5 seconds and heart rate variability every 5 minutes, with an S11 chip and a ceramic case option.
summary_zh: 苹果在“Surprise and shine”发布会上发布Apple Watch Series 12，起价399美元，9月9日预购，9月18日到店。其核心健康传感系统每5秒测心率、每5分钟测心率变异性，搭载S11芯片并提供陶瓷表壳选项。

title_en: Apple unveils iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone, starting at $1,999
title_zh: 苹果发布首款折叠 iPhone——iPhone Duo，起价1,999美元
summary_en: Apple introduced iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone, opened as the thinnest iPhone ever with a 7.6-inch inner display and closed with a 5.4-inch outer display delivering 90% of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Powered by A20 Pro with a vapor chamber and dual-battery architecture, it comes in star white and night sky, with pre-orders beginning Friday, October 16 and availability beginning Friday, October 23.
summary_zh: 苹果发布首款折叠iPhone——iPhone Duo，展开时为史上最薄iPhone，配备7.6英寸内屏；合盖时5.4英寸外屏提供iPhone 18 Pro约90%的屏幕面积。它搭载A20 Pro、均热板和双电池架构，有星白色和夜空色，10月16日星期五预购，10月23日星期五发售。

title_en: Apple introduces AirPods 5 with open-ear Active Noise Cancellation at $129
title_zh: 苹果发布 AirPods 5，开放式主动降噪，129美元起
summary_en: Apple announced AirPods 5 with what it calls the industry's best Active Noise Cancellation in an open-ear design, removing up to 50% more external noise than AirPods 4 with ANC, at $129, or $149 with a Wireless Charging Case. Customers could pre-order starting September 9, with availability in stores beginning Friday, September 18.
summary_zh: 苹果发布AirPods 5，称其开放式设计的主动降噪为业界最佳，比AirPods 4降噪款多消除高达50%的外部噪音，售价129美元，无线充电盒版149美元。9月9日起可预购，9月18日星期五到店发售。

title_en: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
title_zh: 苹果发布 iPhone 18 Pro 与 iPhone 18 Pro Max
summary_en: Apple introduced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, with pre-orders beginning Saturday, September 12 and availability beginning Friday, September 18. Apple described advances in camera, performance, battery and intelligence, including variable aperture on the 48MP Fusion Main camera.
summary_zh: 苹果发布 iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max，9月12日星期六预购，9月18日星期五发售。苹果称其在相机、性能、电池和智能方面取得进步，包括48MP融合主摄的可变光圈。

title_en: A20 Pro brings 2nm chip, up to 40% faster graphics to iPhone 18 Pro and Duo
title_zh: A20 Pro 带来2纳米芯片，图形性能最高提升40%
summary_en: Apple introduced A20 Pro with the iPhone 18 Pro models, moving to a 2-nanometer process with a six-core CPU and seven-core GPU that Apple claimed delivers up to 40% faster graphics than A19 Pro. The chip includes a dual 16-core Neural Engine and is also used in the iPhone Duo.
summary_zh: 苹果随iPhone 18 Pro机型发布A20 Pro，采用2纳米工艺，配备六核CPU和七核GPU，苹果称图形性能比A19 Pro最高快40%。该芯片还包括双16核神经引擎，也用于iPhone Duo。

title_en: Foldable iPhone production reportedly faces delays ahead of unveiling
title_zh: 报道：折叠 iPhone 在发布前面临量产延迟
summary_en: A September 8 report citing Nikkei Asia said Apple was struggling to raise production of its first foldable iPhone, with daily output at only a few hundred units in late August due to extra trial production over surface flatness and hinge performance. The device was expected to be unveiled September 9 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models.
summary_zh: 9月8日援引Nikkei Asia的报道称，苹果难以提升首款折叠iPhone的产量，因表面平整度和铰链性能而增加试产后，8月下旬日产量仅数百台。该设备预计于9月9日与iPhone 18 Pro机型一同发布。

title_en: Foldable iPhone production hitting just 'a few hundred' a day, says Nikkei
title_zh: Nikkei：折叠 iPhone 日产量仅“数百台”
summary_en: Nikkei Asia supply-chain sources reported production of the upcoming foldable iPhone was ramping slowly at only a few hundred units a day in late August, with surface flatness and hinge yields as bottlenecks. Nikkei had previously reported Apple raised its order to around 10 million units, up from 7-8 million.
summary_zh: Nikkei Asia供应链消息称，即将推出的折叠iPhone量产爬坡缓慢，8月下旬日产量仅数百台，表面平整度和铰链良率为瓶颈。Nikkei此前曾报道苹果已将订单提升至约1,000万台，高于此前的700万至800万台。

title_en: John Ternus takes over as Apple CEO on September 1
title_zh: John Ternus 于9月1日接任苹果 CEO
summary_en: John Ternus, Apple's former senior vice president of hardware engineering, took over as CEO on Tuesday, September 1, succeeding Tim Cook, who announced in April he was stepping down after 15 years and would remain as executive chairman. The change came days before Apple's September 9 event.
summary_zh: 苹果前硬件工程高级副总裁John Ternus于9月1日星期二接任CEO，接替Tim Cook；Cook于4月宣布在任职15年后卸任，并将留任执行董事长。此次交接发生在苹果9月9日发布会前几天。

title_en: Claimed folding iPhone motherboards shown in leaked images
title_zh: 疑似折叠 iPhone 主板在泄露图片中曝光
summary_en: Images claimed to show the folding iPhone's motherboard circulated on X and Chinese social media on August 26, with two seemingly separate leakers producing images that appeared to show the same components. AppleInsider noted the authenticity could not be confirmed until a device was bought and stripped down.
summary_zh: 8月26日，声称展示折叠iPhone主板的图片在X和中国社交媒体流传，两名看似独立的爆料者发布的图片似乎显示相同组件。AppleInsider指出，在有人购机拆解前，其真实性无法确认。

title_en: Apple sets 'Surprise and shine' launch event for September 9
title_zh: 苹果定于9月9日举行“Surprise and shine”发布会
summary_en: Apple sent invitations on August 26 for a special event dubbed 'Surprise and shine' at the Steve Jobs Theater in Apple Park on September 9, beginning at 10 a.m. Pacific. Cult of Mac reported the first folding iPhone was expected to be the star, along with iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.
summary_zh: 苹果于8月26日发出邀请，定于9月9日上午10点（太平洋时间）在Apple Park的Steve Jobs剧院举行名为“Surprise and shine”的特别活动。Cult of Mac报道称，首款折叠iPhone预计将与iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max一同成为焦点。

title_en: Apple releases fifth iOS 27 public betas
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 27 第五个公开测试版
summary_en: Apple released the fifth public betas of iOS 27, iPadOS 27, tvOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate on August 24, a week after the fourth betas and hours after the seventh developer betas. MacRumors noted no notable new features were found in that day's developer betas as testing neared its end.
summary_zh: 苹果于8月24日发布iOS 27、iPadOS 27、tvOS 27和macOS Golden Gate的第五个公开测试版，距第四个测试版一周，距第七个开发者测试版数小时。MacRumors指出，当天的开发者测试版未发现值得注意的新功能，测试已接近尾声。

title_en: iOS 27 beta 5 exposes six iPhone 18 model identifiers, including foldable
title_zh: iOS 27 测试版5曝光六款 iPhone 18 机型标识，包括折叠款
summary_en: References in iOS 27 beta 5, reported August 12, listed six unreleased iPhone identifiers including V68 expected to be the foldable model then rumored as iPhone Ultra, alongside Pro, standard, Air 2 and 18e models. The report, based on Macworld and 9to5Mac findings in battery files, treated the fall launch as centered on the premium tier.
summary_zh: 8月12日报道称，iOS 27测试版5中的引用列出六款未发布iPhone标识，包括预计为折叠款、当时被传为iPhone Ultra的V68，以及Pro、标准版、Air 2和18e机型。该报道基于Macworld和9to5Mac在电池文件中的发现，认为秋季发布将以高端机型为核心。

title_en: Fifth developer betas of iOS 27 and macOS 27 land
title_zh: iOS 27 与 macOS 27 第五个开发者测试版发布
summary_en: Apple reached the fifth round of developer betas for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, tvOS 27, watchOS 27 and visionOS 27 on August 10, following the fourth round on July 20. iOS 27 beta 5 was build 24A5408d.
summary_zh: 苹果于8月10日发布iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27 Golden Gate、tvOS 27、watchOS 27和visionOS 27的第五轮开发者测试版，此前第四轮于7月20日发布。iOS 27测试版5的构建号为24A5408d。

title_en: Apple reports third quarter results: revenue $109.4 billion, up 16%
title_zh: 苹果公布第三季度业绩：营收1,094亿美元，同比增长16%
summary_en: Apple reported fiscal 2026 third-quarter results for the quarter ended June 27, 2026, with revenue of $109.4 billion, up 16% year over year, and diluted EPS of $2.02, up 29%. Apple said iPhone, Mac and Services set June-quarter records and its installed base reached a new all-time high.
summary_zh: 苹果公布截至2026年6月27日的2026财年第三季度业绩，营收1,094亿美元，同比增长16%，稀释每股收益2.02美元，同比增长29%。苹果称iPhone、Mac和服务均创下6月季度纪录，活跃设备装机量创历史新高。

title_en: iOS 27 public beta goes live on July 13
title_zh: iOS 27 公开测试版于7月13日上线
summary_en: The iOS 27 public beta went live on July 13, 2026, matching developer beta 3 and opening the update to anyone in Apple's free Beta Software Program with a compatible iPhone. It offered the first public chance to try Siri AI, a Liquid Glass customization slider, and a reworked Screen Time system.
summary_zh: iOS 27公开测试版于2026年7月13日上线，与开发者测试版3相同，向苹果免费Beta软件计划中拥有兼容iPhone的任何人开放。这是公众首次试用Siri AI、Liquid Glass自定义滑杆和改版屏幕使用时间的机会。

title_en: iOS 27 beta 3 enables Siri AI voice customization
title_zh: iOS 27 测试版3启用 Siri AI 语音自定义
summary_en: Apple's third iOS 27 developer beta on July 6 enabled Siri AI voice customization with Pace and Expressivity sliders, previously labeled 'Coming soon,' for devices with the A19 Pro chip and at least 12GB of RAM such as iPhone Air and iPhone 17 Pro models. The beta also updated the Siri animation and renamed the indexing message to 'Optimizing Search and Siri.'
summary_zh: 苹果7月6日的iOS 27第三个开发者测试版为搭载A19 Pro芯片且至少12GB内存的设备（如iPhone Air和iPhone 17 Pro机型）启用了此前标为“即将推出”的Siri AI语音自定义，提供语速和表现力滑杆。该测试版还更新了Siri动画，并将索引提示改名为“正在优化搜索与Siri”。

title_en: Apple ramps foldable iPhone production to 10 million units, Nikkei reports
title_zh: Nikkei：苹果将折叠 iPhone 产量提升至1,000万台
summary_en: Nikkei Asia reported Apple told suppliers to prepare to make approximately 10 million foldable iPhones in 2026, up from a previous forecast of about 7-8 million, and had booked parts for roughly 80 million smartphones for the second half including iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and the foldable. The foldable was then rumored under names including iPhone Ultra.
summary_zh: Nikkei Asia报道，苹果已告知供应商准备在2026年生产约1,000万台折叠iPhone，高于此前约700万至800万台的预期，并已为下半年订购约8,000万台智能手机的零部件，包括iPhone 18 Pro、Pro Max和折叠款。当时折叠款被传名为iPhone Ultra等。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 26.5.2 with security fixes
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.5.2 安全更新
summary_en: Apple released iOS 26.5.2 and iPadOS 26.5.2 on June 29, 2026. Apple's security notes list fixes for vulnerabilities including WebKit and kernel issues, with no new features described.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年6月29日发布 iOS 26.5.2 和 iPadOS 26.5.2。苹果安全说明列出了包括 WebKit 和内核问题在内的漏洞修复，未描述新功能。

title_en: Apple raises Mac, iPad, Vision Pro and home device prices citing memory costs
title_zh: 苹果以内存成本为由上调 Mac、iPad 等产品价格
summary_en: On June 25, 2026, Apple raised prices on MacBooks, iPads, Vision Pro, HomePod and Apple TV, citing memory and storage costs it said it could no longer absorb. Examples reported include MacBook Air rising from $1,099 to $1,299 and the entry iPad from $349 to $449, while iPhone prices were unchanged.
summary_zh: 2026年6月25日，苹果上调 MacBook、iPad、Vision Pro、HomePod 和 Apple TV 价格，称内存和存储成本已无法继续自行吸收。报道的例子包括 MacBook Air 从1099美元涨至1299美元、入门 iPad 从349美元涨至449美元，iPhone 价格不变。

title_en: Foldable iPhone 'Ultra' set for production in July despite hinge issues, report says
title_zh: 报道称折叠 iPhone“Ultra”尽管有铰链问题仍将于7月投产
summary_en: The Elec, via MacRumors on June 24, reported the foldable iPhone is expected to begin mass production at the end of July, still targeting a September launch despite hinge durability challenges in testing. The report said the device uses a foldable 7.8-inch OLED panel supplied by Samsung.
summary_zh: MacRumors 6月24日援引 The Elec 报道，折叠 iPhone 预计将于7月底开始量产，尽管测试中出现铰链耐久性挑战，仍目标9月发布。报道称该机使用三星供应的7.8英寸可折叠 OLED 面板。

title_en: Gurman: second-generation foldable iPhone codenamed V78 planned for 2027
title_zh: Gurman：第二代折叠 iPhone 代号 V78，计划2027年推出
summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported on June 16, 2026 that Apple is already developing a second-generation foldable iPhone, codenamed V78, for 2027 alongside the 20th-anniversary iPhone. The report suggested Apple plans to refresh its foldable lineup yearly.
summary_zh: 彭博社 Mark Gurman 于2026年6月16日报道，苹果已在开发第二代折叠 iPhone，代号 V78，计划2027年与20周年 iPhone 一同推出。报道称苹果计划每年更新折叠产品线。

title_en: iOS 27 and macOS 27 betas contain references pointing to a foldable iPhone
title_zh: iOS 27 和 macOS 27 测试版出现指向折叠 iPhone 的代码引用
summary_en: Developers and Bloomberg's Mark Gurman noted iOS 27 beta references to 'foldState' and 'angleDegrees', multiple displays, and a resizable iPhone Mirroring window in macOS 27. Gurman argued the changes were made to support a folding iPhone form factor, though Apple had not announced the device.
summary_zh: 开发者和彭博社 Mark Gurman 注意到 iOS 27 测试版中有“foldState”和“angleDegrees”、多显示屏等引用，以及 macOS 27 中可拉伸的 iPhone 镜像窗口。Gurman 认为这些改动是为折叠 iPhone 形态做准备，但苹果当时尚未宣布该设备。

title_en: watchOS 27 narrows support to Series 9 and later, Ultra 2 and later, and SE 3
title_zh: watchOS 27 仅支持 Series 9 及后续、Ultra 2 及后续和 SE 3
summary_en: The watchOS 27 compatibility list confirmed at WWDC on June 8 covers Apple Watch Series 9, 10 and 11, Ultra 2 and Ultra 3, and SE 3, dropping Series 6-8, the original Ultra and SE 2. Coverage noted new features including Siri AI and an upgraded Workout Buddy for supported watches.
summary_zh: 在 WWDC 上确认的 watchOS 27 兼容名单包括 Apple Watch Series 9、10、11、Ultra 2、Ultra 3 和 SE 3，不再支持 Series 6-8、初代 Ultra 和 SE 2。报道提到受支持手表将获得 Siri AI 和升级的 Workout Buddy 等新功能。

title_en: WWDC26: Apple previews iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27 and tvOS 27
title_zh: WWDC26：苹果预告 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27、visionOS 27 和 tvOS 27
summary_en: At WWDC26 on June 8, 2026, Apple previewed upcoming software releases delivering the next generation of Apple Intelligence across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27 and tvOS 27. Apple said the releases would be faster, more reliable and more delightful, with developer testing starting that day.
summary_zh: 2026年6月8日，苹果在 WWDC26 预告了即将发布的软件，下一代 Apple Intelligence 将登陆 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27、visionOS 27 和 tvOS 27。苹果称新系统更快、更可靠、更愉悦，开发者测试当天开始。

title_en: Apple announces tvOS 27 with redesigned Podcasts app and faster performance
title_zh: 苹果发布 tvOS 27：播客应用改版、性能更快
summary_en: Apple announced tvOS 27 at WWDC on June 8, 2026, with a briefly shown slide listing a redesigned Podcasts app, smoother app launches and animations, faster AirPlay, smart downloads, a Larger Text accessibility option and a more responsive Control Center. The first developer beta was available that day, with a public beta to follow in July.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年6月8日在 WWDC 发布 tvOS 27，简短展示的幻灯片列出播客应用改版、更流畅的应用启动和动画、更快的 AirPlay、智能下载、更大的文字无障碍选项和更灵敏的控制中心。首个开发者测试版当天提供，公开测试版将于7月跟进。

title_en: Apple introduces Siri AI, a more capable and personal assistant
title_zh: 苹果推出 Siri AI：更强大、更懂个人的助理
summary_en: Apple introduced Siri AI on June 8, 2026, describing it as an entirely new Siri powered by Apple Intelligence with personal context understanding, broad world knowledge and onscreen awareness. It includes a dedicated app to revisit conversations, an expanded Visual Intelligence experience and integrated writing tools, available for developer testing that day and as a user beta later in 2026.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年6月8日推出 Siri AI，称其为由 Apple Intelligence 驱动的全新 Siri，具备个人上下文理解、广泛世界知识和屏幕感知能力。它包含可回顾对话的独立应用、扩展的 Visual Intelligence 体验和集成写作工具，当天开放开发者测试，年内晚些时候提供用户测试版。

title_en: macOS 27 'Golden Gate' announced, dropping Intel Macs and refining Liquid Glass
title_zh: macOS 27“Golden Gate”发布：放弃 Intel Mac 并优化 Liquid Glass
summary_en: Apple announced macOS 27 'Golden Gate' at WWDC on June 8, 2026, the first macOS release to run exclusively on Apple silicon. It adds a global slider to adjust Liquid Glass opacity, tighter window corner radius, Siri AI and Apple Intelligence upgrades, according to reports of the keynote.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年6月8日在 WWDC 发布 macOS 27“Golden Gate”，这是首个仅运行于 Apple 芯片的 macOS。据 keynote 报道，它新增调节 Liquid Glass 不透明度的全局滑块、更紧凑的窗口圆角，以及 Siri AI 和 Apple Intelligence 升级。

title_en: iOS 27 unveiled at WWDC 2026 with performance gains and iPhone 11 support
title_zh: iOS 27 在 WWDC 2026 发布：性能提升且支持 iPhone 11
summary_en: Apple unveiled iOS 27 on June 8, 2026, with Siri AI, Apple Intelligence features in apps including Safari, Messages, Passwords, Shortcuts and Home, and performance claims including photos loading up to 70% faster and AirDrop up to 80% faster. iOS 27 was announced for iPhone 11 and later, while Siri AI and Apple Intelligence require iPhone 15 Pro models or iPhone 16 and later.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年6月8日发布 iOS 27，带来 Siri AI、在 Safari、信息、密码、快捷指令和家庭等应用中的 Apple Intelligence 功能，以及照片加载快达70%、AirDrop 快达80%等性能宣称。iOS 27 支持 iPhone 11 及后续机型，而 Siri AI 和 Apple Intelligence 需要 iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 16 及后续机型。

title_en: Apple expands child safety with Ask to Browse, Time Allowances and redesigned Screen Time
title_zh: 苹果扩展儿童安全功能：Ask to Browse、Time Allowances 和新版屏幕使用时间
summary_en: As part of its June 8, 2026 WWDC releases, Apple announced powerful new parental tools to help parents create safe digital experiences for kids. Reported details include Ask to Browse website approvals, Time Allowances for app categories, and Communication Safety expanded to violent content in addition to nudity.
summary_zh: 作为2026年6月8日 WWDC 发布的一部分，苹果宣布了强大的新家长工具，帮助家长为孩子营造安全的数字体验。报道的细节包括网站访问审批 Ask to Browse、按应用类别设定的 Time Allowances，以及从裸露内容扩展到暴力内容的通信安全功能。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 26.5.1 to fix wired charging on iPhone Air and iPhone 17 models
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.5.1，修复 iPhone Air 和 iPhone 17 有线充电问题
summary_en: Apple released iOS 26.5.1 on June 1, 2026, three weeks after iOS 26.5, for iPhone Air and iPhone 17 models. Apple's notes said it addresses an issue that could prevent wired charging when the battery is nearly drained for a small number of users.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年6月1日发布 iOS 26.5.1，距 iOS 26.5 约三周，面向 iPhone Air 和 iPhone 17 机型。苹果说明称它修复了少数用户在电量几乎耗尽时可能无法有线充电的问题。

title_en: Foldable 'iPhone Ultra' rumored to feature vapor chamber cooling
title_zh: 传闻折叠“iPhone Ultra”将采用均热板散热
summary_en: MacRumors reported on June 1, 2026 that the foldable iPhone was rumored to feature vapor chamber cooling despite its thin design. The report was set against separate claims of pre-assembly yield problems and hinge quality issues, while Bloomberg had reported in April that the device remained on track for a September debut.
summary_zh: MacRumors 于2026年6月1日报道，折叠 iPhone 传闻将采用均热板散热，尽管机身很薄。该报道背景是另有预组装良率问题和铰链质量问题的说法，而彭博社4月曾报道该设备仍按计划9月亮相。

title_en: Foldable iPhone case listings leak design details
title_zh: 折叠 iPhone 保护壳 listing 泄露设计细节
summary_en: Case listings reported on May 28, 2026 purported to show Apple's foldable iPhone, with coverage citing rumored specs including a 5.5-inch outer display, 7.8-inch inner display, 4.5mm unfolded profile, side-mounted Touch ID and dual 48MP rear cameras. The coverage cautioned that accessory leaks do not always reflect final hardware.
summary_zh: 2026年5月28日报道的保护壳 listing 据称展示了苹果折叠 iPhone，报道援引的传闻规格包括5.5英寸外屏、7.8英寸内屏、展开厚度4.5mm、侧边 Touch ID 和双4800万像素后置摄像头。报道提醒配件泄露不一定反映最终硬件。

title_en: Apple announces WWDC 2026 schedule and sends media invites for June 8-12
title_zh: 苹果公布 WWDC 2026 日程并发出6月8-12日媒体邀请
summary_en: Apple on May 18, 2026 provided the schedule for WWDC 2026, running June 8 to June 12, and sent media invites for an in-person keynote viewing at Apple Park. The keynote was confirmed for 10:00 a.m. Pacific on June 8, streaming on Apple.com, the Apple TV app and YouTube.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年5月18日公布 WWDC 2026 日程，会议为6月8日至12日，并发出在 Apple Park 现场观看 keynote 的媒体邀请。Keynote 确认于6月8日太平洋时间上午10点举行，将在 Apple.com、Apple TV 应用和 YouTube 直播。

title_en: Foldable iPhone production stalls amid hinge issues, leaker claims
title_zh: 爆料称折叠 iPhone 生产因铰链问题受阻
summary_en: MacRumors reported on May 18, 2026 that leaker Instant Digital said foldable iPhone production was stalling amid hinge difficulties, while the display could maintain a visually crease-free state over the long term in tests. Earlier DigiTimes reporting said production was one to two months behind schedule but a fall launch remained on track.
summary_zh: MacRumors 于2026年5月18日报道，爆料者 Instant Digital 称折叠 iPhone 生产因铰链困难受阻，而测试显示屏幕长期可保持视觉上无折痕。此前 DigiTimes 报道称生产落后约一到两个月，但秋季发布仍在计划内。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 26.5 with end-to-end encrypted RCS, Pride wallpaper and Maps Suggested Places
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.5：端到端加密 RCS、Pride 壁纸和地图推荐地点
summary_en: Apple released iOS 26.5 and iPadOS 26.5 on May 11, 2026. The update added end-to-end encrypted RCS messaging (beta, with supported carriers), a Pride Luminance wallpaper, and Suggested Places in Maps based on trending nearby places and recent searches.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年5月11日发布 iOS 26.5 和 iPadOS 26.5。该更新加入端到端加密 RCS 信息（测试版，需运营商支持）、Pride Luminance 壁纸，以及根据附近热门地点和近期搜索推荐的地图“推荐地点”。

title_en: Apple's 2026 Pride Collection arrives with Pride Edition Sport Loop
title_zh: 苹果2026 Pride 系列上市：Pride 版运动型表带
summary_en: Apple's 2026 Pride Collection became available on May 4, 2026, led by a $49 Pride Edition Sport Loop woven from nylon yarns in 11 colors. It was accompanied by a matching Pride Luminance watch face and wallpapers arriving with iOS, iPadOS and watchOS 26.5.
summary_zh: 苹果2026 Pride 系列于2026年5月4日上市，主打49美元的 Pride 版运动型表带，由11种颜色的尼龙纱线织成。配套的 Pride Luminance 表盘和壁纸随 iOS、iPadOS 和 watchOS 26.5 推出。

title_en: Apple reports record March quarter: $111.2B revenue, $100B buyback and higher dividend
title_zh: 苹果公布创纪录3月季度业绩：营收1112亿美元、1000亿美元回购并提高股息
summary_en: Apple reported fiscal Q2 2026 results on April 30, 2026, with revenue of $111.2 billion, described as its best March quarter ever, and EPS of $2.01, up 22% year over year. The board authorized an additional $100 billion share repurchase and raised the quarterly dividend to $0.27 per share.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年4月30日公布2026财年第二季度业绩，营收1112亿美元，称其为有史以来最好的3月季度，每股收益2.01美元，同比增长22%。董事会批准新增1000亿美元股票回购，并将季度股息提高至每股0.27美元。

title_en: Reports claim 'iPhone Ultra' name locked in for Apple's first foldable
title_zh: 报道称苹果首款折叠机已定名“iPhone Ultra”
summary_en: Reports on April 27, 2026 claimed Apple had locked in the 'iPhone Ultra' name for its first folding iPhone, alongside a possible touchscreen MacBook Ultra. Apple had not confirmed any name at the time, and the claim was based on unnamed sources cited by Macworld and others.
summary_zh: 2026年4月27日的报道称，苹果已为其首款折叠 iPhone 定名“iPhone Ultra”，同时可能还有触屏 MacBook Ultra。苹果当时未确认任何名称，该说法基于 Macworld 等援引的匿名消息来源。

title_en: Tim Cook to step down as CEO; John Ternus to take over September 1
title_zh: Tim Cook 将卸任 CEO，John Ternus 将于9月1日接任
summary_en: Apple announced on April 20, 2026 that Tim Cook will step down as CEO and become executive chairman on September 1, 2026, with hardware engineering chief John Ternus taking over as CEO and joining the board. Cook was to remain CEO through the summer to work with Ternus on the transition.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年4月20日宣布，Tim Cook 将卸任 CEO 并于2026年9月1日转任执行董事长，硬件工程负责人 John Ternus 将接任 CEO 并加入董事会。Cook 将在夏季继续担任 CEO，与 Ternus 共同完成交接。

title_en: Apple releases iOS 26.4.1 with bug fixes
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.4.1 修复更新
summary_en: Apple released iOS 26.4.1 and iPadOS 26.4.1 on April 8, 2026, build 23E254, a little over two weeks after iOS 26.4. Apple's notes described unspecified bug fixes with no security fixes listed; reporting linked the update to an iCloud syncing bug affecting CloudKit apps.
summary_zh: 苹果于2026年4月8日发布 iOS 26.4.1 和 iPadOS 26.4.1，构建号23E254，距 iOS 26.4 约两周多。苹果说明仅称包含未具体说明的错误修复、无安全修复列出；报道将该更新与影响 CloudKit 应用的 iCloud 同步问题联系起来。

summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said Apple's first foldable iPhone, expected to open book-style with iPad-like multitasking in iOS 27, will be the most significant overhaul in iPhone history. Reports at the time pointed to a roughly 7.7-inch inner display, a 5.3-inch outer display, Touch ID instead of Face ID, and a U.S. starting price at or above $1,999.
summary_zh: 彭博社古尔曼称，苹果首款折叠 iPhone 预计采用书本式开合、并在 iOS 27 中支持类似 iPad 的多任务，将是 iPhone 历史上最重大的变革。当时报道称其内屏约 7.7 英寸、外屏 5.3 英寸，采用 Touch ID 而非 Face ID，美国起售价不低于 1999 美元。
title_en: Gurman: Foldable iPhone Will Be 'Most Significant Overhaul in the iPhone's History'
title_zh: 古尔曼：折叠 iPhone 将是“iPhone 历史上最重大的变革”

summary_en: Apple released iOS 26.4 and iPadOS 26.4 on March 24, six weeks after iOS 26.3. It added Apple Music's AI Playlist Playground, Concerts, offline music recognition, eight new emoji, Purchase Sharing payment changes, Freeform image tools and accessibility improvements — but no revamped Siri.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 24 日发布 iOS 26.4 和 iPadOS 26.4，距 iOS 26.3 约六周。新版加入 Apple Music 的 AI 播放列表游乐场、演唱会发现、离线音乐识别、8 个新表情、购买共享付款变化、Freeform 图像工具和无障碍改进——但没有新版 Siri。
title_en: Apple Releases iOS 26.4 With Playlist Playground, New Emoji and Purchase Sharing Changes
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.4：带来播放列表游乐场、新表情和购买共享变化

summary_en: Apple announced its annual Worldwide Developers Conference will be held online June 8–12, 2026, with a special in-person event at Apple Park on June 8. Apple said WWDC26 will spotlight platform updates including AI advancements and new software and developer tools.
summary_zh: 苹果宣布年度全球开发者大会将于 2026 年 6 月 8 日至 12 日在线举行，6 月 8 日在 Apple Park 设有特别线下活动。苹果称 WWDC26 将重点展示包括 AI 进展在内的平台更新，以及新软件和开发者工具。
title_en: Apple Announces WWDC26 Will Run June 8–12, 2026
title_zh: 苹果宣布 WWDC26 将于 2026 年 6 月 8 日至 12 日举行

summary_en: Apple announced AirPods Max 2 on March 16, powered by the H2 chip with up to 1.5x more effective Active Noise Cancellation, enhanced sound, and Adaptive Audio, Conversation Awareness, Voice Isolation and Live Translation for the first time on AirPods Max. Orders were set to start March 25, with availability in early April.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 16 日发布 AirPods Max 2，搭载 H2 芯片，主动降噪效果最高提升至 1.5 倍，音质增强，并首次在 AirPods Max 上带来自适应音频、对话感知、语音突显和实时翻译。3 月 25 日起订购，4 月初上市。
title_en: Apple Introduces AirPods Max 2 With H2 Chip and Better ANC
title_zh: 苹果推出 AirPods Max 2：搭载 H2 芯片、降噪更强

summary_en: Korea's The Bell reported, via MacRumors, that Apple's first foldable iPhone would use 12GB of RAM supplied by Samsung, with DRAM shipments to begin in the second quarter of 2026. The report described the device as a wider, book-style foldable closer to an iPad mini when open, expected to launch in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models.
summary_zh: 据 MacRumors 转引韩国《The Bell》报道，苹果首款折叠 iPhone 将采用三星供应的 12GB 内存，DRAM 出货将于 2026 年第二季度开始。报道称该机为较宽的书本式折叠，展开后接近 iPad mini 大小，预计 9 月与 iPhone 18 Pro 系列一同发布。
title_en: Report: Foldable iPhone's 12GB RAM to Be Supplied by Samsung
title_zh: 报道：折叠 iPhone 的 12GB 内存将由三星供应

summary_en: Apple introduced MacBook Neo on March 4, a new 13-inch laptop powered by the A18 Pro chip from the iPhone 16 Pro line, starting at $599 ($499 for education). It weighs 2.7 pounds, offers up to 16 hours of battery life, and comes in blush, indigo, silver and citrus, with availability from March 11.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 4 日推出 MacBook Neo，这款 13 英寸新笔记本搭载源自 iPhone 16 Pro 系列的 A18 Pro 芯片，起售价 599 美元（教育价 499 美元）。机身重 2.7 磅，续航最长 16 小时，有腮红、靛蓝、银色和柑橘四色，3 月 11 日起上市。
title_en: Apple Introduces MacBook Neo, Its Most Affordable MacBook at $599
title_zh: 苹果推出 MacBook Neo：599 美元起、最便宜的 MacBook

summary_en: Apple released iOS 26.3.1 and iPadOS 26.3.1 on March 4, three weeks after iOS 26.3. According to Apple's release notes, the update adds support for the new Studio Display and Studio Display XDR and includes unspecified bug fixes.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 4 日发布 iOS 26.3.1 和 iPadOS 26.3.1，距 iOS 26.3 约三周。据苹果发行说明，此更新新增对新款 Studio Display 和 Studio Display XDR 的支持，并包含未具体说明的错误修复。
title_en: Apple Releases iOS 26.3.1 With Bug Fixes and Studio Display Support
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.3.1：修复错误并支持新款 Studio Display

summary_en: Apple announced a new Studio Display and an all-new Studio Display XDR on March 3. The XDR model has a 27-inch 5K Retina XDR display with mini-LED backlighting, up to 2,000 nits peak HDR brightness and a 120Hz refresh rate; prices start at $1,599 and $3,299, with availability from March 11.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 3 日发布新款 Studio Display 和全新 Studio Display XDR。XDR 机型配备 27 英寸 5K Retina XDR 显示屏，采用 mini-LED 背光，HDR 峰值亮度达 2000 尼特，刷新率 120Hz；起售价分别为 1599 美元和 3299 美元，3 月 11 日起上市。
title_en: Apple Unveils New Studio Display and All-New Studio Display XDR
title_zh: 苹果发布新款 Studio Display 与全新 Studio Display XDR

summary_en: Apple announced new 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips on March 3, built on a new Fusion Architecture with a Neural Accelerator in each GPU core. The models start at 1TB (M5 Pro) and 2TB (M5 Max) storage, add the N1 chip for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, and offer up to 24 hours of battery life, with availability from March 11.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 3 日发布搭载 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max 芯片的新款 14 英寸和 16 英寸 MacBook Pro，采用全新 Fusion 架构，每个 GPU 核心均内置神经加速器。起步存储为 1TB（M5 Pro）和 2TB（M5 Max），新增 N1 芯片支持 Wi-Fi 7 和蓝牙 6，续航最长 24 小时，3 月 11 日起上市。
title_en: Apple Introduces MacBook Pro With All-New M5 Pro and M5 Max
title_zh: 苹果推出搭载全新 M5 Pro 与 M5 Max 的 MacBook Pro

summary_en: Apple announced the MacBook Air with M5 on March 3, with a faster CPU, next-generation GPU with Neural Accelerators, and double the starting storage at 512GB. Apple's N1 chip adds Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, battery life is up to 18 hours, and the 13- and 15-inch models went on pre-order March 4 with availability from March 11.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 3 日发布搭载 M5 的 MacBook Air，CPU 更快，GPU 为带神经加速器的新一代，起步存储翻倍至 512GB。N1 芯片带来 Wi-Fi 7 和蓝牙 6，续航最长 18 小时，13 英寸和 15 英寸机型 3 月 4 日起预订，3 月 11 日起上市。
title_en: Apple Introduces the New MacBook Air With M5
title_zh: 苹果推出搭载 M5 芯片的新款 MacBook Air

summary_en: Apple announced iPhone 17e on March 2 as the most affordable iPhone 17 model, with the A19 chip, the faster C1X modem, a 48MP Fusion camera and Ceramic Shield 2. It adds MagSafe and doubles starting storage to 256GB at the same $599 starting price, with pre-orders from March 4 and availability from March 11.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 2 日发布 iPhone 17e，作为 iPhone 17 系列中最实惠的机型，搭载 A19 芯片、更快的 C1X 调制解调器、48MP 融合式摄像头和第二代超瓷晶面板。它新增 MagSafe，起步存储翻倍至 256GB，起售价仍为 599 美元，3 月 4 日起预订，3 月 11 日起上市。
title_en: Apple Introduces iPhone 17e With A19, MagSafe and 256GB Starting Storage
title_zh: 苹果推出 iPhone 17e：A19 芯片、MagSafe、256GB 起步存储

summary_en: Apple announced the new iPad Air with the M4 chip on March 2, saying it is up to 30 percent faster than the M3 model and now has 12GB of unified memory — 50 percent more than before. It adds Apple's N1 and C1X connectivity chips with Wi-Fi 7, in 11- and 13-inch sizes at the same starting price, with availability from March 11.
summary_zh: 苹果于 3 月 2 日发布搭载 M4 芯片的新款 iPad Air，称其比 M3 机型快最高 30%，统一内存增至 12GB，比上一代多 50%。它新增苹果 N1 和 C1X 连接芯片并支持 Wi-Fi 7，提供 11 英寸和 13 英寸两种尺寸，起售价不变，3 月 11 日起上市。
title_en: Apple Introduces the New iPad Air Powered by M4
title_zh: 苹果推出搭载 M4 芯片的新款 iPad Air

summary_en: Bloomberg reported on February 11, via PYMNTS, that Apple planned to delay several new Siri capabilities expected in iOS 26.4 in March, spreading them to iOS 26.5 in May and iOS 27 in September. The delayed features reportedly included Siri tapping into personal data such as old text messages and performing multiple in-app actions from a single command.
summary_zh: 据 PYMNTS 转引彭博社 2 月 11 日报道，苹果计划推迟原定于 3 月随 iOS 26.4 推出的多项 Siri 新功能，分散至 5 月的 iOS 26.5 和 9 月的 iOS 27。据称被推迟的功能包括让 Siri 调用旧短信等个人数据、以及用一条指令执行多个 App 内操作。
title_en: Report: Apple Delays Several New Siri Features Beyond iOS 26.4
title_zh: 报道：苹果将多项 Siri 新功能推迟至 iOS 26.4 之后

summary_en: Apple released iOS 26.3 and iPadOS 26.3 on February 11, almost two months after iOS 26.2. The update added a built-in tool for transferring photos, messages, notes, apps, passwords and more to an Android device during setup, a setting to limit carrier location tracking on devices with C1 or C1X modems, and dozens of security fixes.
summary_zh: 苹果于 2 月 11 日发布 iOS 26.3 和 iPadOS 26.3，距 iOS 26.2 近两个月。此更新加入内置的安卓迁移工具，可在设置时转移照片、信息、备忘录、App、密码等；还为搭载 C1 或 C1X 调制解调器的设备加入限制运营商定位追踪的设置，并包含数十项安全修复。
title_en: Apple Releases iOS 26.3 With Android Transfer Tool and Location Privacy Setting
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.3：加入安卓迁移工具与定位隐私设置

summary_en: Apple reported fiscal Q1 2026 results on January 29 for the quarter ended December 27, 2025, with record revenue of $143.8 billion, up 16 percent year over year, and diluted EPS of $2.84. iPhone revenue hit a record $85.3 billion, up 23 percent, and Services revenue reached $30.0 billion.
summary_zh: 苹果于 1 月 29 日公布截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日的 2026 财年第一季度业绩，营收创纪录达 1438 亿美元，同比增长 16%，稀释每股收益 2.84 美元。iPhone 收入创纪录达 853 亿美元，同比增长 23%，服务收入达 300 亿美元。
title_en: Apple Reports Record $143.8 Billion Quarter on $85.3 Billion iPhone Revenue
title_zh: 苹果公布创纪录季度：营收 1438 亿美元，iPhone 收入 853 亿美元

summary_en: Apple released iOS, iPadOS and watchOS 26.2.1 on January 26, its first software updates of 2026. The releases add support for the second-generation AirTag announced the same day, along with unspecified bug fixes.
summary_zh: 苹果于 1 月 26 日发布 iOS、iPadOS 和 watchOS 26.2.1，这是其 2026 年首批软件更新。此版本新增对同日发布的第二代 AirTag 的支持，并包含未具体说明的错误修复。
title_en: Apple Releases iOS 26.2.1 With Support for the New AirTag
title_zh: 苹果发布 iOS 26.2.1：支持新款 AirTag

summary_en: Apple unveiled the second-generation AirTag on January 26, with its second-generation Ultra Wideband chip enabling Precision Finding from up to 50 percent farther away and a speaker 50 percent louder than before. It keeps the same design and price — $29 for one or $99 for a four-pack — and adds Precision Finding on Apple Watch Series 9 or later and Ultra 2 or later.
summary_zh: 苹果于 1 月 26 日推出第二代 AirTag，搭载第二代超宽频芯片，精确查找距离最高提升 50%，扬声器音量比上一代大 50%。外观与价格不变——单只 29 美元、四只装 99 美元——并新增在 Apple Watch Series 9 或更新机型及 Ultra 2 或更新机型上使用精确查找。
title_en: Apple Introduces New AirTag With Expanded Range and a Louder Speaker
title_zh: 苹果推出新款 AirTag：范围更广、扬声器更响

summary_en: Analyst Jeff Pu's January investor note, reported by MacRumors on January 16, projected that Apple's foldable iPhone would share the A20 Pro chip, 12GB of RAM, 48MP rear cameras and the C2 modem with the iPhone 18 Pro models. Pu's note was part of reporting that placed the foldable's debut in September 2026 alongside the Pro models, with the regular iPhone 18 following in spring 2027.
summary_zh: 据 MacRumors 1 月 16 日报道，分析师 Jeff Pu 在 1 月的投资者报告中预计，苹果折叠 iPhone 将与 iPhone 18 Pro 机型共用 A20 Pro 芯片、12GB 内存、48MP 后置摄像头和 C2 调制解调器。该报告将折叠机型的发布时间定在 2026 年 9 月、与 Pro 机型同期，普通版 iPhone 18 则推至 2027 年春季。
title_en: Analyst: Foldable iPhone and iPhone 18 Pro to Share A20 Pro Chip and 12GB RAM
title_zh: 分析师：折叠 iPhone 与 iPhone 18 Pro 将共用 A20 Pro 芯片和 12GB 内存

summary_en: Apple unveiled Apple Creator Studio on January 13, bundling Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor and MainStage plus new AI features and premium content in Keynote, Pages and Numbers into a single subscription. It launched January 28 at $12.99 per month or $129 per year in the U.S., with education pricing of $2.99 per month.
summary_zh: 苹果于 1 月 13 日推出 Apple Creator Studio，将 Final Cut Pro、Logic Pro、Pixelmator Pro、Motion、Compressor 和 MainStage 以及 Keynote、Pages、Numbers 的新 AI 功能与高级内容整合为一个订阅服务。该服务于 1 月 28 日上线，美国定价每月 12.99 美元或每年 129 美元，教育价每月 2.99 美元。
title_en: Apple Introduces Creator Studio Subscription for Pro Creative Apps
title_zh: 苹果推出 Creator Studio 订阅：整合专业创作 App

summary_en: Apple and Google announced a multi-year partnership on January 12 under which the next generation of Apple Foundation Models will be based on Google's Gemini models and cloud technology. The companies said the models will help power future Apple Intelligence features, including a more personalized Siri due later in 2026, while Apple Intelligence continues to run on Apple devices and Private Cloud Compute.
summary_zh: 苹果与谷歌于 1 月 12 日宣布多年合作：下一代苹果基础模型将基于谷歌的 Gemini 模型和云技术。双方称这些模型将驱动未来的 Apple Intelligence 功能，包括将于 2026 年晚些时候推出的更个性化的 Siri，同时 Apple Intelligence 将继续在苹果设备和私有云计算上运行。
title_en: Apple and Google Announce Gemini Partnership to Power Future Siri and Apple Foundation Models
title_zh: 苹果与谷歌宣布 Gemini 合作：将驱动未来 Siri 与苹果基础模型
